name: year
description: Reference year of the inventory (Australian financial year ending; 1990 = 1989-90)

name: geography
description: Geographic area: 'australia' (national) or one of the eight states/territories, plus 'et' (external territories)
observations: Australia is the national aggregate; states/territories follow the ASGS. Not directory-linked because the national aggregate has no id_state. 'et' = external/other territories.

name: anzsic_level_1
description: ANZSIC economic-sector classification (division: e.g. B Mining, C Manufacturing)

name: anzsic_level_2
description: ANZSIC economic-sector classification, level 2 (sub-category; NULL where the branch is shallower)

name: anzsic_level_3
description: ANZSIC economic-sector classification, level 3 (sub-category; NULL where the branch is shallower)

name: gas_level_0
description: Gas or metric: a physical gas/pollutant (CO2, CH4, N2O, ...) or the aggregate 'CO2-e - AR5' (CO2-equivalent, AR5 100-year GWP)

name: gas_level_1
description: For 'CO2-e - AR5' rows, the contributing gas (CO2, CH4, N2O, Other); NULL for physical-gas rows

name: gas_level_2
description: Sub-group of the CO2-e 'Other' contribution (HFC, PFC, SF6); NULL otherwise

name: gas_level_3
description: Specific species within the CO2-e sub-group (e.g. HFC-134a, CF4); NULL otherwise

name: emissions_gg
description: Emissions in gigagrams (Gg). For gas 'CO2-e - AR5' the unit is Gg CO2-equivalent (Mt CO2-e = value/1000); for a physical gas it is Gg of that gas
observations: Source measure, not converted. LULUCF (a UNFCCC category) can be negative (net sink).
